YOUR BROWSER ONLY

Behavior before opinions.

Your play history is a test of the instrument,
not evidence of market demand.

How to run a useful test

Recruit 20–30 people from the same intended audience. Let the assigned game go first, ask them to try both once, then leave replay optional. Avoid coaching or naming a favorite. This is an exploratory test, not a statistically conclusive study.

Compare: people who voluntarily replay / people who finish a first round; abandoned rounds; active play time; stated preference after both games; and returns on a later local calendar day. Review results separately by first-game order.

Return-day records only show whether that game was played on another day in the same browser. They do not measure D1 retention. Cross-device play and cleared storage cannot be linked. Collect each tester’s export manually; there is no central analytics server.
